string.text: The town bears the grim scars of the Great Plague. Streets are choked with quarantine braziers, citizens wear linen mouth-wraps, and mass graves lie just beyond the walls.
The village struggles in the wake of the pestilence. Smoldering sulfur fires line the perimeter, overgrown weeds choke unworked plots, and surviving kin guard their meager grain stores with scythes.
Dark days... The pestilence took half our kindred, and now ruthless warlords fight over whatever scrap of land is left.
The contagion carried off the best smiths and reapers. The few who survived demand royal silver or took to the hills as bandits.[rf:confused_annoyed]
Wary travels, friend. We burn incense and boil our water at every stop—half the caravans on these roads are carrying the sickness or stripped by plague bandits.
Starving outlaws and plague vagrants lurk beyond the boundary cairns. What good are our taxes if the lord leaves us to fend off desperate survivors alone?
Plague scavengers and desperate deserters prowl the roads outside our gates. The realm fractured, and no captain has come to clear them.
Thank the heavens for {NOTABLE.LINK}. When the fever took our neighbors, {?NOTABLE.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} distributed clean flour and guarded the quarantine line.
They say {NOTABLE.LINK} quarantined three workers from the {.%}{SHOP_TYPE}{.%} the moment they started coughing. Cruel perhaps, but nobody in that quarter has caught the fever yet.
These are dark times. The plague broke all laws—don't worry overmuch about the fate of outlaws.
All right - we give up! Sickness starved our kin and drove us to the road, but we cannot fight soldiers. Show what mercy you can...
You'll never take us alive! Better a clean blade than dying of the black fever in some lord's dungeon![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
So that's how it is, is it? We survived the pestilence; we won't die on our knees! I'll make you bleed before I fall![if:convo_angry][ib:aggressive]
Hold there... You're traveling through our quarantine ground. You don't pass without leaving a toll.
Back off! Dozens of our kin are hidden just beyond that ridge, and every one of us has buried a family and has nothing left to lose.
You don't know who you're dealing with. The woods are full of desperate men who fled the sickness. Step closer and you'll find arrows in your throat.

The Calradians pride themselves on discipline, heavy armor, and master combined-arms warfare.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- INFANTRY: Imperial Legionaries form one of the toughest defensive shieldwalls in Calradia, equipped with heavy armor, broad shields, and throwing pilums. Supported by Veteran Menavliatons, lethal two-handed polearm shock troops specialized in cleaving cavalry.{newline}- RANGED: Versatile missile options. Imperial Palatine Guards provide rapid composite bow fire, while Imperial Sergeant Crossbowmen wield heavy pavise shields and armor-piercing crossbows.{newline}- CAVALRY: Elite Imperial Cataphracts represent the most heavily armored shock lance cavalry on the continent. Imperial Bucellarii provide mobile mounted archery support.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Highly adaptable combined-arms doctrine with outstanding armor, strong shields, and answers to every battlefield threat.

The feudal lords of Vlandia dominate open battlefields through crushing shock cavalry charges and heavy crossbow salvos.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- CAVALRY: Vlandian Banner Knights deliver the most devastating couched-lance heavy cavalry charge in Calradia, supported by agile Vanguard lancers. (Note: No horse archers).{newline}- RANGED: Vlandian Sharpshooters wield high-damage heavy crossbows and pavise shields. Exceptional in defensive sieges and lethal at medium range, with formidable melee stats.{newline}- INFANTRY: Vlandian Sergeants hold solid spear-and-shield formations, while Voulgiers and Pikemen wield brutal two-handed polearms designed to halt enemy cavalry charges and cleave enemy frontlines.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Heavy cavalry hammer and crossbow anvil. Devastating in open plains, but lacks horse archers and requires cavalry micro.

Masters of woodland ambushes, skirmishing, and guerrilla tactics, the fiercely independent tribes of Battania rule through archery and raw melee ferocity.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- ARCHERS: Battanian Fian Champions are the undisputed kings of archery in Calradia—possessing unmatched longbow range, arrow velocity, and rate of fire. When closed upon, they draw two-handed greatswords and fight as lethal shock infantry.{newline}- INFANTRY: High-damage skirmishers and shock troops. Battanian Wildlings unleash devastating volleys of heavy throwing javelins before closing in, while Oathsworn form sturdy shieldwalls and Veteran Falxmen cleave enemy lines with hooked blades.{newline}- CAVALRY: Battanian Mounted Skirmishers provide light javelin cavalry for harassment only. (Note: No heavy shock cavalry or horse archers).{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Unrivaled missile supremacy and javelin skirmishing. Excels in forests and uneven terrain, but vulnerable to open-field cavalry charges if caught without infantry screens.

Born of the frozen northern forests and coastlines, Sturgian warbands crush their adversaries with impenetrable shieldwalls and brutal close-quarters axes.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- INFANTRY: The strongest shieldwall infantry in Calradia. Sturgian Heavy Axemen carry massive round shields, lethal axes with bonus damage against shields, and throwing axes. Heavy Spearmen brace against cavalry charges, while Heroic Line Breakers swing devastating two-handed executioner axes that obliterate infantry formations.{newline}- CAVALRY: Sturgian Druzhinnik Champions are heavily armored noble cavalry with round shields and heavy lances, capable of dismounting as Tier-6 heavy shock infantry. (Note: No horse archers).{newline}- RANGED: Sturgian Veteran Bowmen provide light skirmish support; lacks crossbows and elite ranged specialists.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Grinding infantry superiority and defensive shieldwalls. Dominates chokepoints and infantry clashes, but relies on sturdy formation play to counter heavy missile fire.

Rulers of the southern dunes and sun-scorched oases, the Banu Asera field fast, flexible, and balanced armies adept in mobile skirmishing.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- CAVALRY: High-mobility noble warfare. Aserai Vanguard Faris are elite cavalry armed with broad shields, spears, and lethal armor-piercing Jarid throwing javelins. Supported by Mameluke Heavy Cavalry.{newline}- RANGED: Aserai Master Archers possess some of the highest bow handling and rapid-fire archery in Calradia. Mameluke Heavy Horse Archers offer mobile mounted archery.{newline}- INFANTRY: Aserai Veteran Infantry are versatile frontline fighters carrying broad shields, swords, and throwing javelins. Mameluke Palace Guards wield fearsome two-handed crescent axes that shred infantry lines.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Highly versatile combined-arms with strong skirmish throwing weapons across both infantry and noble cavalry. Excels at hit-and-run tactics and mobile field battles.

Riders of the eastern steppe seas, the Khuzait Khanate overwhelms opponents with unrivaled horse archery, superior mobility, and swift encirclement.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- HORSE ARCHERS: The premier horse archer faction in Calradia. Khuzait Heavy Horse Archers encircle enemy lines with endless composite bow fire. The noble Khuzait Khan's Guard is the deadliest hybrid unit in the game, wielding pinpoint accurate recurve bows and lethal polearm glaives that destroy opponents in melee.{newline}- CAVALRY: Khuzait Heavy Lancers execute rapid shock flank attacks to disrupt enemy formations.{newline}- INFANTRY: Khuzait Darkhans form sturdy spear-and-shield formations to protect backlines and hold chokepoints. Supported by Khuzait Marksmen bowmen.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Total cavalry and horse-archer dominance. Unbeatable in wide open plains through continuous skirmishing, though requires discipline in tight mountainous terrain and sieges.
